title: How to Patch in RPG Maker XP

posts.author: KanliBicak
posts.body:
I made a game in
RPG Maker XP
, but since the game is in Turkish, I cannot send it to my foreign friends.
Can I patch a foreign language simply?

posts.author: SGD
posts.body:
Simple answer: No.
If you never used a multi lang script or similar the only way is to manually translate everything.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
As said above, if you never prepared for that option it is rather difficult to add.
However there might be something that can partially help you:
Please look if you can find a program to extract and inject texts from a RMXP-game.
That way you would only translate the text files and won't have to search every event trhough every map.
I do not know if such a program exists for RMXP, but there were commonly used in RM2K(3) and exist for a few later makers (VXA), so there are good chances that it exists (or existed) somewhere.
